data.title: Call capture heartbeat missing on one managed edge
data.business_impact: One operator may see delayed call filing. Existing business records remain available.
data.next_action: Verify whether the edge process or its heartbeat collector stopped

facts.text: The last accepted heartbeat was at 21:41Z.
The server record gateway remains reachable.

hypotheses.text: The local process may be asleep or logged out.
The heartbeat collector may have lost permission.

workspace_banner.workaround: Use the call review queue after the edge reconnects.
